summary: DeFi Technologies filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing its October 1, 2026 news release with a September corporate update. The company reported Valour AUM of $640.2 million as of September 25, 2026, up $243 million or 61.2% from $397.2 million at June 30, 2026, alongside month-over-month net inflows, a new Valour Funds SPC and Smart Crypto Fund SP launch, and approximately $135 million in balance-sheet liquidity with no debt. No transaction, securities offer, or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is an operational update, not a special situation.
